prompt: Three fire hydrants sit along one straight sidewalk: first $A$, then $B$, then $C$. If $AB = 7$ m and $BC = 5$ m, how many meters is $AC$?
hint: Walking from $A$ to $C$ means walking $A$ to $B$ and then $B$ to $C$.

hints.text: Walking from $A$ to $C$ means walking $A$ to $B$ and then $B$ to $C$.
The Segment Addition Postulate says $AB + BC = AC$ when $B$ is between $A$ and $C$.

explanation: Because $B$ sits between $A$ and $C$, the two short walks stack end to end.

alternativeExplanations.title: Pace it out
steps: Take 7 steps from $A$ and you are standing at $B$.
Take 5 more and you are at $C$. Nobody undid any steps, so the whole trip is $7 + 5 = 12$ m.
